runtime_sources.spacr/measure.py:_report_steps_not_on_th: [measure] {what} ({key}) does not run on the spaCR store yet; the measurements are in the store and this step is skipped.

measurement_backend.text: Where Measure, Make Masks and every later step keep the measurement tables: spacr_store, the only value. Each object table goes to the spaCR store in the measurements folder, one Parquet part per table and well in the recorded per-column dtypes, with one DuckDB catalog (spacr.duckdb); spacr.store.open and every spaCR reader open it. measurements.db is no longer written; an older project that has one is still read. The retired values still load: sqlite means spacr_store, and duckdb, parquet or postgres mean spacr_store plus that copy as an export of the finished tables. Default spacr_store.

measurement_backend_target.text: Where the export of a retired measurement_backend value (duckdb, parquet or postgres) goes: a DuckDB file, a Parquet folder or a PostgreSQL connection string. Blank puts measurements.duckdb or measurements.parquetdb in the measurements folder, and reaches PostgreSQL through the PGHOST, PGDATABASE, PGUSER and PGPASSWORD environment variables. Keep passwords in ~/.pgpass, not here. Ignored for spacr_store. Default blank.
